## Problem 1

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

```{r}
n_rows <- nrow(penguins)
n_columns <- ncol(penguins)
mean_flipper_length <- mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
```
The `penguins` dataset contains measurements for penguins from three species: `r paste(unique(penguins$species), collapse = ", ")`, collected from the islands `r paste(unique(penguins$island), collapse = ", ")`. Important variables include `bill_length_mm`, `bill_depth_mm`, `flipper_length_mm`, `body_mass_g`, `sex`, and `year`. The dataset contains `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns. The mean flipper length is `r round(mean_flipper_length, 2)` mm.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

penguin_plot <- ggplot(
  penguins,
  aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)
) +
  geom_point()

penguin_plot
ggsave("penguin_scatterplot.png", plot = penguin_plot)
```
